item_short_desc: Rothco's Army Style C-Cell Flashlight is built for tactical applications, outdoor adventures, and everyday home use, offering a bright and reliable light source. Constructed with a metal clip for easy attachment to your tactical belt and a metal ring on the bottom for securing to other outdoor gear, this survival flashlight is designed for convenience and portability. The camping flashlight operates on 2 C-cell batteries (not included) and comes with 4 extra interchangeable lenses in blue, red, yellow, and green.
description: Rothco's Army Style C-Cell Flashlight is built for tactical applications, outdoor adventures, and everyday home use, offering a bright and reliable light source. Constructed with a metal clip for easy attachment to your tactical belt and a metal ring on the bottom for securing to other outdoor gear, this survival flashlight is designed for convenience and portability. The camping flashlight operates on 2 C-cell batteries (not included) and comes with 4 extra interchangeable lenses in blue, red, yellow, and green, allowing you to adapt the light to different environments and tasks. Additionally, the tactical flashlight features a spare bulb stored beneath the battery spring, ensuring you’re never left in the dark. Whether you're preparing for emergencies, outdoor adventures, or need a dependable light at home, this flashlight is a versatile and essential tool.
